key_insight: The paper argues for a quality-assured intelligent welding workflow that connects process monitoring to digital closed-loop control for aerospace manufacturing.
engineering_relevance: This matters because closed-loop monitoring and control can improve weld consistency, reduce defects, and support certification-grade production of aerospace structures.
method: Monitor welding process signals in real time
Use intelligent analytics to assess process quality
Feed monitoring results back into a digital closed-loop manufacturing system
evidence_signal: The abstract provides only bibliographic metadata and does not report specific datasets, metrics, or quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: A major implementation concern is whether the monitoring and control system generalizes reliably across different aerospace materials, joint geometries, and production conditions.
paper_title: Toward quality-assured intelligent welding processes for aerospace structures: From process monitoring to digital closed-loop manufacturing
